title: Emotional Escalation Awareness
description: This course helps participants recognise emotional escalation patterns and develop strategies to prevent harm.
learningOutcomes: Recognise early signs of emotional overload.

modules.title: Understanding Escalation
modules.content: Explores emotional triggers and escalation cycles.

modules.title: Impact on Others
modules.content: Shows how escalation creates fear and instability.

modules.title: De-escalation Tools
modules.content: Provides grounding, breathing, and self-regulation strategies.
